programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: A man is convinced his girlfriend is sneaking around - and he has proof! He wants a DNA test for two children.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: A man survived cancer and claims his treatment killed any chance that he's the father of girlfriend's baby.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: Shocked and surprised, a Los Angeles man discovers he owes $35,000 in child support!

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: She tragically lost her son and is desperate to find out if he fathered a baby girl before he lost his life.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: Judge Lauren Lake updates us on some of the most shocking family secrets ever to appear in Paternity Court.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: A one-night-stand comes back to haunt a Missouri man who's accused of getting a woman pregnant 3 years ago.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: A woman comes to Paternity Court to keep her high school sweetheart in her life.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: Will a relationship plagued with constant "tit for tat" cheating come together for the paternity of a baby?

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: A mother and daughter relationship is on the line when a prior guest returns to DNA test her possible father.

programme.title: Paternity Court
programme.desc: A man says that his ex's baby looks nothing like him. She gets lots of late night calls, so whose baby is it?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best cropMrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheatbecause of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge-with uncontrollable and deadly results!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world...and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study...from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home...a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life....including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche

programme.title: La familia P. Luche

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Al morir, don Severino, tío de Ludovico, deja escrita una última voluntad: que su sobrino conviva con sus cenizas por dos días a cambio de heredarle toda su fortuna.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Cuando Ludovico escucha que don Camerino busca a una mujer, decide presentarle a Lucrecia, su cuñada. Sin embargo, todo resulta ser una divertida confusión.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Sin nada que perder y dejando sus penas atrás, comienza la historia de estos cinco personajes que son unidos por el destino y el amor a la música.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Albertano y el Vítor deciden trabajar de mariachis y hacen un casting para conformar su grupo. Tras armar uno con sus vecinos, usan una grabadora para llevar sus serenatas.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos

programme.title: Una familia de diez

programme.desc: Celina asiste a su primera cita médica. Marina le pide perdón a Franco por haberlo abandonado. Miguel le pide a Mía que le ayude a recordar sobre su novia, pero él cree que su novia es Sabrina. Diego es despedido de su trabajo por culpa de su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no perdona a Franco por mentirle toda su vida sobre el presunto fallecimiento de su madre. Miguel no acepta hacer la rehabilitación y Franco habla con él. Javier es inculpado en el robo de tangas y calzones a las alumnas de Elite Way.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía le confiesa la verdad a Madariaga sobre las amenazas de León para que aceptara entrar en sus negocios; Mía quiere localizar a su mamá, pero Franco le dice que desapareció de nuevo; Miguel le pregunta a Diego y Roberta si Mía era su novia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía pone un anuncio en el periódico para localizar a su mamá; Pascual se niega a desafiar a León por no perder su empleo; León manda a secuestrar a Diego para utilizarlo como un golpe publicitario para su campaña; Mía y Marina se encuentran.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta termina su noviazgo con Diego por aceptar los chantajes de León. Marina le explica a Mía por qué se fue. Gandía se niega a renunciar al colegio. Mía planea irse a vivir con su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le pide permiso a Franco para irse a vivir con Marina, si las cosas salen bien. Sol, bajo el nombre de Vico, le informa a la mamá de Celina que su hija está embarazada. Celina le dice a su mamá que se va a casar con Max.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco le ofrece la patria potestad de Mía a Marina. Giovanni se hace pasar por gay para engañar al papá de Javier. Roberta acepta a Colucci como la pareja de su mamá. Miguel busca hablar con Mía para reconciliarse.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía perdona a su papá. Marina le promete a Mía salir de sus adicciones. León es detenido acusado de malos manejos. Mía le ruega a Miguel que no se vaya a Monterrey porque lo ama. Diego le dice a Roberta que la ama.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco y Alma se casan, José les agradece aceptarla en su familia. Diego y Roberta se reconcilian. Miguel le pide a Mía que se case con él. Pascual clausura el curso. Roberta les dice a todos que RBD seguirá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se queda sin vacaciones por hacer un striptease. Por su parte, Diego sufre un accidente por conducir ebrio. Roberta es obligada a estudiar en la Elite Way School.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta intenta no ser admitida en el colegio. Por su parte, Miguel deja Monterrey, y se le dificulta presentar su examen de admisión en la Elite Way School. Además, Lupita puede estudiar gracias a su tía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mayra ayuda a Miguel a entrar a la escuela. Miguel, Lupita y Nico hacen su examen para entrar a la escuela. Por su parte, los chicos de cuarto año se van de viaje a Vallarta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta casi se ahoga y Mauro la salva. Diego va a una iglesia a hacer servicio comunitario y un tipo lo golpea.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta y Mía se pelean por el profesor. Pero la que termina ganando la pelea es Alma, la mamá de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel amenaza a Mía por humillar a Celina. Diego intenta vengarse de la persona que lo agredió, pero su padre interviene entregando al matón a la Policía. Roberta, movida por los celos, insulta a Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El papá de Mía llega al Vacance Club y conoce a Miguel. Mientras tanto, Diego se pone muy borracho y Mía lo ayuda. Alma y Franco se conocen en la carretera.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le pide a Celina que sea su novia. Por su parte, Alma le manda un arreglo de Flores a Franco para agradecerle. En plan de hacerse la vida imposible, Diego empuja a Roberta al lago y ella casi se ahoga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le pide a Franco una foto de su madre. Diego amenaza a Roberta, pero León los interrumpe. Miguel se acerca a Franco con el pretexto de pedirle una entrevista para una tarea. Nico se golpea la cabeza peleando con Miguel tras insultarlo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita ya no quiere compartir la habitación con Roberta. Toda esta situación hace que Roberta se sienta discriminada por los chicos del colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina le advierte a Lupita que se aleje de Miguel; Roberta comprueba que no es una ladrona; Diego es humillado frente a todos; León le regala un automóvil al director; Roberta inventa que Franco acosa a Alma; Mía fotografía a Lupita y Miguel juntos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco se enfurece al saber que lo culpan de acosar sexualmente a Alma y amenaza con demandarla; Pilar acusa a su padre de corrupto; Roberta insiste en entrar al grupo coreográfico; Alma recibe una llamada del abogado de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no puede evitar soñar con Miguel y se imagina besándolo. Roberta le confiesa a su madre que se inventó el chisme de su acosador. Tomás cree que Pilar es su admiradora. Miguel se presenta a la madre de Celina como su novio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Fabián le cede a Marcelino a Roberta; Vico llega a la fiesta de Diego y lo abofetea por no invitarla; en un programa de televisión, Alma acepta que Franco nunca la acosó sexualmente; Vico es quien intenta seducir a Tomás.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta insiste en entrar al grupo de baile; Miguel se enoja con Celina por celosa; Franco descubre que Miguel le mintió y el director quiere sancionarlo; José ayuda a Roberta a ocultar a Marcelino; Miguel miente y recupera la confianza de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta logra formar su grupo coreográfico. Franco investiga a Miguel y su apellido se le hace familiar. Pilar escribe sobre Giovanni en sus anónimos y él la amenaza. Diego descubre que Roberta esconde a un niño. Mía enfrenta a Miguel y la besa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel pactan una tregua y fingen no gustarse; culpan a Lupita de chismosa; el director descubre al niño que esconde y Roberta lo saca del colegio; Roberta lee su ensayo sobre Diego; Miguel encuentra un papel con la marca de la logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel es elegido por la logia; José es mordido por uno de los perros de León por evitar que encuentre a Marcelino; Mía sospecha que Vico oculta algo; Lupita se va del colegio por lo que dicen de ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Roberta van a buscar a Lupita. La logia cita a Miguel en el sótano de la escuela y lo torturan para que acepte dejar la escuela.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Los chicos se escapan del colegio para ir a una fiesta que organizó Roberta en un antro. Roberta y Diego se besan.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina se emborracha por Miguel. Mientras tanto, los estudiantes son castigados por escaparse del colegio. Por su parte, Giovanni le dice a Diego que Tomás le quiere bajar a Vico.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego recibe mensajes anónimos que dicen que Vico y Tomás son pareja. Por su parte, Gandía solicita que Roberta comience un tratamiento psicológico para no expulsarla. Los Logios intentan arrollar a Miguel con una camioneta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel inventa que le preocupa Celina, para entrar a casa de Mía. Por su parte, Roberta tendrá que llevar a Marcelino a una casa hogar. Mientras tanto, la logia decide dejar a Miguel en paz por un tiempo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le pide a Celina que entre al grupo de baile de Mía, pero ella la rechaza. Por su parte, Roberta le pide a su mamá ropa para el grupo de baile.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no pasa la prueba de baile. Roberta y sus amigas dan una gran impresión en el concurso de baile. Por su parte, Celina rompe su amistad con Mía Coluchi.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta se convierte en la esclava de Diego con tal de que no la delate. Por su parte, Pascual le avisa a Vico que tiene que irse del colegio. Mía y Roberta se pelean a golpes en clase.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina amenaza a Miguel con suicidarse si la deja. Mientras tanto, Roberta descubre que a Lupita su mamá la odia. La maestra de baile quiere que regrese Mía al grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma llega a la terapia de Roberta y descubre que la que asiste a las sesiones es Lupita. Por su parte, Celina intenta entregarse a Miguel y él le dice que la quiere como amiga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Castigan a Mía por encabezar la manifestación a favor de Vico. Marcelino demuestra a Roberta cuanto la quiere.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía intenta besar a Miguel, pero no se atreve. Mientras tanto, Alma cuestiona a Roberta en qué gasta tanto dinero. Además, Franco no quiere que Roberta sea amiga de Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no tiene permiso para salir del colegio y se le arruina su cita. Por lo tanto, Lupita ayuda a escapar a Mía para buscar a Joaquín. Roberta cree tener la forma para que Diego la deje de chantajear.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El chantaje de Roberta no funciona, pero escapa de Diego. Por su parte, Franco le pide a Miguel vigilar a Mía. Además, Nico acepta que le gusta Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Joaquín sale con Roberta y Mía al mismo tiempo, sin que ellas lo sepan. Para eso, cuando las ve en público no las trata bien.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Joaquín trata de aprovecharse de Roberta y Mía, mientras ellas creen en su amor. Roberta le ruega a Alma que no envíe a Marcelino a un orfanato.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar deja otro anónimo sobre Marcelino y Pascual descubre todo. Además, Roberta le reclama a Diego por chismoso y en venganza enviará su casete con su nombre a las estaciones de radio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Marcelino le pide perdón a Roberta por creer que lo traicionó. Por su parte, Mía no acepta las disculpas de Celina. Mientras tanto, Giovanni acusa a Pilar de emborrachar a Diego para sacarle información.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta amenaza a Pilar con delatarla. Por su parte, León se entera del casete de Diego y lo golpea, pero Tomás se echa a sí mismo la culpa. Celina le advierte a Mía que no tenga relaciones con Joaquín porque anda con Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le regala un traje a Celina para el grupo de baile. Por su parte, León enviará a Diego a un colegio Militarizado. Sin verlo venir, Joaquín se entera de que Alma es mamá de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma aconseja a Mía esperar para tener relaciones sexuales. Por su parte, Roberta le dice a Alma que rompió con Joaquín y que está embarazada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Joaquín busca a Roberta para que regresen. Mía se entera de que Miguel le inventó a Joaquín que su papá es narco. Finalmente, Roberta no acepta tener relaciones con Joaquín.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le dice a Joaquín la verdad sobre Franco. Además, León amenaza a Mabel con dejarla en la calle y quitarle a Diego. Por su parte, Roberta se enoja con Enrique por querer andar con Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta golpea a Vico por inventar que anda con Teo. Por su parte, Joaquín le cuenta a Roberta sobre la muerte del hermano de Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mabel le pide a Diego quedarse con su papá, porque no quiere que lo lastime. Por su parte, Roberta le aclara a Teo que él no es culpable de la muerte de su hermano. Diego le dice a Roberta que Joaquín la engaña con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Teo quiere saber si es verdad que su hermano estaba drogado cuando se accidentó, pero sus padres lo niegan; Roberta le dice a Mía que Joaquín anda con las dos y, al vengarse de él, le provoca un accidente; todos creen que Nico es dueño de un café.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Los López son hipnotizados y despiertan disfrazados de personajes de cuento de hadas, además de que Plácido ha desaparecido. Gaby y Plutarco tendrán que descubrir qué fue lo que hizo la familia mientras estuvieron hipnotizados.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina está actuando raro y la familia López cree que está poseída. Justito busca demostrar que sabe jugar al béisbol, y Victoria quiere entrar al equipo de béisbol varonil, a pesar de que el entrenador no se lo permite.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plutarco y Adolfo hacen un casting para participar en luchas profesionales. Victoria se pone celosa porque Justito está enamorado de una chica nueva de su salón y ya no quiere jugar con ella.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plutarco y Gaby deciden buscar su propio departamento. Martina tiene mala suerte por no compartir una imagen en redes sociales. Tulio y Gertrudis son descubiertos besándose en el elevador.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Es Nochebuena y los López están tristes, ya que no tienen dinero para regalos ni para la cena, pero dos personas llegan sorpresivamente a cambiar la noche y hacer que sea una Navidad memorable para todos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Es el día del santoral de Plácido y quiere festejarlo con una cena, pero la falta de presupuesto complica el plan. Además, Tulio se fue de la casa y la familia debe decidir si Gertrudis se va o se queda con ellos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se queda sin pensión por error y debe conseguir un nuevo trabajo para mantener a su familia. Mientras tanto, un exnovio de la Nena vuelve para conquistarla, pero Adolfo trata de impedirlo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina convence a la tía Licha de hacerle una broma a la Nena para que no extrañe a Adolfo. Mientras tanto, Justito sufre las molestias de unos compañeros.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El exnovio de Carlos regresa a casa de los López para pedir asilo. Además, Plácido y Adolfo consiguen un nuevo trabajo, pero también una nueva deuda.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina quiere volverse influencer para mantenerse económicamente. El gobierno ha confiscado el departamento de Licha.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Después de pasar la noche en una carpa, Licha le pasa sus males a Carlos. Plácido y Adolfo reciben un ataque de palomas en la playa.

programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

Adam Lerner has always tried to take good care of his health, so it comes as a cruel surprise when he learns that he has malignant tumors along his spine. His doctor gives him a 50/50 chance of survival, but Adam tries to remain upbeat, though his mother and his friend Kyle, react badly to the news. Adam starts seeing a therapist, but their relationship threatens to cross the boundary between doctor and patient.

In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most.

programme.desc: Un gallero es asesinado en su palenque, y su esposa muere al dar a luz. Un amigo de ellos lleva al niño con su abuela.

programme.desc: Tres amigos, dos de ellos casados, deciden obtener un poco de diversión, pero las esposas no lo permitirán.

programme.title: Los corrompidos
programme.desc: En un gran hotel hay de todo, una telefonista ninfómana, un recepcionista jugador y un elevadorista inescrupuloso.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.desc: Santa y el mago Merlín se unen para frustrar los planes del diablo de extender la tentación entre los niños del mundo.

programme.desc: Un hombre mata a su hijo, se vuelve alcohólico, pierde a su mujer, tiene alucinaciones y un pacto con el diablo.

programme.title: Matar por matar
programme.desc: La posesión de un revólver determina la vida y la muerte de quienes lo empuñan en un determinado momento.

programme.title: Veneno para las Hadas
programme.desc: Un par de amigas de 10 años, deciden preparar un veneno para las hadas, ya que una de ella se siente bruja.

programme.title: Tráiganlos vivos o muertos
programme.desc: Una mujer roba un banco mientras su cómplice y amante dispara a los banqueros protegiéndola en su huida.

programme.title: Jóvenes Delincuentes
programme.desc: Jóvenes se encuentran atrapados en un mundo de drogas y crímenes del que es casi imposible escapar.

programme.title: La Ley de las Calles
programme.desc: Después de cuatro años un hombre es liberado de la cárcel y al salir es atacado por los hermanos de su novia.

programme.title: El Día del Compadre
programme.desc: Durante la víspera del Día del Compadre, los habitantes de un condominio se preparan para festejar entre risas, juegos y riñas.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Visita al Pasado
programme.desc: Un grupo de niños que viaja a través del tiempo al siglo XVII hacen frente a un castillo embrujado.

programme.title: S.O.S. Conspiración Bikini
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de mujeres hermosas, una organización internacional de terroristas crean problemas en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: Elena y Raquel
programme.desc: Una joven está embarazada de un novio que la abandonó y odia al bebé, pero al nacer cambian sus sentimientos hacia el menor.

programme.title: La cárcel de Laredo
programme.desc: Un hombre poderoso separa a su hija del novio, un mecánico, y lo envía a la prisión, a pesar de que la joven está embarazada.
